      const filterJobTitle = document.getElementById('filterJobTitle') ? document.getElementById('filterJobTitle').value : 'all';

      // Determine active filter state
      const isFilterActive = (filterStaffShift !== 'all') || (filterSearchKeyword !== '') || (filterBranch !== 'all') || (filterSection !== 'all') || (filterJobTitle !== 'all');

      // Update Filter Trigger Button Active Styling
      const filterBtn = document.querySelector('.filter-trigger-btn');
      if (filterBtn) {
        if (isFilterActive) {
          filterBtn.style.background = 'var(--purple-primary)';
          filterBtn.style.color = '#ffffff';
          filterBtn.style.borderColor = 'var(--purple-primary)';
        } else {
          filterBtn.style.background = '';
          filterBtn.style.color = '';
          filterBtn.style.borderColor = '';
        }
      }

      // Old filter summary removed since it's merged into the filter card above

      container.innerHTML = '';

      let eligibleCount = 0;
      let totalCount = 0;
      let selectedCount = 0;

      staffDatabase.forEach(emp => {
        // 1. Keyword search (Name or ID)
        if (filterSearchKeyword) {
          const matchName = emp.name.toLowerCase().includes(filterSearchKeyword);
          const matchId = emp.id.toLowerCase().includes(filterSearchKeyword);
          if (!matchName && !matchId) return;
        }

        // 2. Staff Shift filter
        if (filterStaffShift !== 'all' && emp.currentShift !== filterStaffShift) {
          return;
        }

        // 3. Branch filter
        if (filterBranch !== 'all' && emp.branch && emp.branch !== filterBranch) {
          return;
        }

        // 4. Section / Department filter
        if (filterSection !== 'all' && emp.section && emp.section !== filterSection) {
          return;
        }

        // 5. Job Title filter
        if (filterJobTitle !== 'all' && emp.jobTitle && emp.jobTitle !== filterJobTitle) {
          return;
        }

        totalCount++;
        const isEligible = currentSelectionMode === 'copy_dates' || emp.eligibleForW02;
        if (isEligible) eligibleCount++;
        if (emp.selected && isEligible) selectedCount++;

        const card = document.createElement('div');
        card.className = `staff-card ${emp.selected && isEligible ? 'selected' : ''} ${!isEligible ? 'disabled' : ''}`;
        card.dataset.staffId = emp.id;
        
        card.onclick = () => {
          if (!isEligible) return;
          emp.selected = !emp.selected;
          renderStaffCards();
          updateStickyBar();
        };

        // Strict AGENTS.md Rule Compliance for Employee ID:
        // Placed directly BELOW employee's name with leading '#' (e.g. #000008) and monospace muted typography
        card.innerHTML = `
          <div class="custom-checkbox">
            <i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i>

        container.appendChild(card);

        container.innerHTML = `
          <div style="text-align: center; padding: 32px 16px; background: var(--bg-card); border: 1px dashed var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 18px; margin: 12px 0;">

      m.style.display = 'flex';

      if (sheet) sheet.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';

    function renderGridCalendar() {
      const year = currentGridMonth.getFullYear();
      const month = currentGridMonth.getMonth();
      
      const monthNames = ["January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"];
      document.getElementById('gridCalTitle').textContent = `${monthNames[month]} ${year}`;
      
      const daysContainer = document.getElementById('gridCalDays');
      daysContainer.innerHTML = '';
      
      const firstDay = new Date(year, month, 1);
      const lastDay = new Date(year, month + 1, 0);
      
      // Calculate day of week of 1st day (0 = Sun, 1 = Mon, ..., 6 = Sat)
      let firstDayIndex = firstDay.getDay() - 1;
      if (firstDayIndex === -1) firstDayIndex = 6; // Make Monday index 0
      
      const daysInMonth = lastDay.getDate();
      
      // Show the previous month's final dates using the same pattern as Leave Calendar.
      const previousMonthLastDay = new Date(year, month, 0).getDate();
      for (let i = 0; i < firstDayIndex; i++) {
        const emptyCell = document.createElement('div');
        emptyCell.className = 'grid-cal-cell empty';
        const previousDate = document.createElement('div');
        previousDate.className = 'grid-cal-date';
        previousDate.textContent = previousMonthLastDay - firstDayIndex + i + 1;
        emptyCell.appendChild(previousDate);
        daysContainer.appendChild(emptyCell);
      }
      
      // Mock Data: specific days with custom numbers
      const mockData = {
        15: { staff: 287, hours: '2,192h' },
        16: { staff: 287, hours: '2,192h' },
        17: { staff: 287, hours: '8h' },
        18: { staff: 287, hours: '8.5h' },
        24: { staff: 287, hours: '0h' },
        25: { staff: 287, hours: '0h' }
      };

      for (let day = 1; day <= daysInMonth; day++) {
        const cell = document.createElement('div');
        cell.className = 'grid-cal-cell';
        if (day === 15) cell.classList.add('selected'); // Hardcoded selected state for demo
        
        cell.onclick = () => {
          document.querySelectorAll('.grid-cal-cell').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('selected'));
          cell.classList.add('selected');
          document.getElementById('calSummaryCard').style.display = 'block';
          selectedCalDateText = new Date(year, month, day).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', {day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric'});
          document.getElementById('calSummaryTitle').textContent = `${new Date(year, month, day).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', {weekday: 'short', day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric'})}`;
        };
        
        const dateEl = document.createElement('div');
        dateEl.className = 'grid-cal-date';
        dateEl.textContent = day;
        cell.appendChild(dateEl);
        
        // Mocking some blank states for realism (e.g. weekends)
        const isWeekend = ((day + firstDayIndex - 1) % 7) >= 5;
        if (false) {
          const blankEl = document.createElement('div');
          blankEl.className = 'grid-cal-empty-text';
          blankEl.textContent = '--';
          cell.appendChild(blankEl);
        } else {
          const staffCount = mockData[day] ? mockData[day].staff : (isWeekend ? 78 : 287);
          const hoursCount = mockData[day] ? mockData[day].hours : (isWeekend ? '132h' : '2,192h');
          
          const staffEl = document.createElement('div');
          staffEl.className = 'grid-cal-stat-staff';
          staffEl.textContent = staffCount;
          
          const hoursEl = document.createElement('div');
          hoursEl.className = 'grid-cal-stat-hours';
          hoursEl.textContent = hoursCount;
          
          cell.appendChild(staffEl);
          cell.appendChild(hoursEl);
        }
        
        daysContainer.appendChild(cell);
      }
      const defaultSelectedDate = new Date(year, month, 15);
      selectedCalDateText = defaultSelectedDate.toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' });
      document.getElementById('calSummaryTitle').textContent = defaultSelectedDate.toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { weekday: 'short', day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' });
